profile.primary_concern: accessing PrEP while living in a shelter

context: Living in a shelter can make accessing healthcare challenging, and I often feel anxious about stigma related to my situation. I want to protect myself but worry about how I would obtain PrEP and whether it is even possible given my circumstances. The fear of being judged and the uncertainty of navigating the healthcare system weigh heavily on my mind.
